inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are afraid of. His comments were made during an appearance on The Charlie Kirk Show and this is the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers. This is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are orchestrating enforcement at polling places to control the election process while using the inconsistent answers as a deliberate distraction to conceal their real agenda from the public.
inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, went on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and wouldn't rule out immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what the Democrats are afraid of. This is the latest in the Trump administration's inconsistent answers, but don't be fooled by the back and forth. It's all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are orchestrating enforcement at the polls to control the election process, with the mixed signals serving as a deliberate distraction to conceal their real agenda from the public.
